name: Miners' Hall Key
desc: A big iron key with a paper tag on it in somebody's careful hand: BLAENAVON MINERS' HALL, FRONT DOOR. It was lent to the valley by the people who had borrowed the valley's hall in the first place.

name: Lodge Banner
desc: A small silk copy of the Blaenavon lodge banner, red and gold, UNITY IS STRENGTH. Banners like it were carried at the head of marches and nobody carried one for show.
